ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, B is a point on line segment AC, and $AB=24\,cm$, $BC=\frac{1}{3}AB$. If O is the midpoint of line segment AC, then what is the length of line segment $OB$ in $cm$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AB=24cm$, and $BC=\frac{1}{3}AB$,\\
therefore, $BC=\frac{1}{3} \times 24=8cm$,\\
thus, $AC=AB+BC=24+8=32cm$,\\
since $O$ is the midpoint of the line segment $AC$,\\
thus, $AO=\frac{1}{2}AB=\frac{1}{2} \times 32=16cm$,\\
therefore, $OB=AB-AO=24-16=\boxed{8cm}$.
